title: HTML & CSS Basics
description: Learn how to build and style modern web pages.

lessons.title: Introduction to HTML
lessons.content: HTML gives structure to a web page using elements such as headings, paragraphs, links and images.

lessons.title: Forms and Inputs
lessons.content: Forms collect information from users with input, label, select and button elements.

lessons.title: CSS Fundamentals
lessons.content: CSS controls colors, spacing, fonts, layouts and responsive design.

title: JavaScript Essentials
description: Add logic and interactivity to websites.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.content: JavaScript variables store values. Use let and const for modern JavaScript.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.content: Functions group reusable instructions and can accept parameters and return values.

lessons.title: DOM Manipulation
lessons.content: The DOM lets JavaScript read and change HTML elements on a page.

title: Java Programming
description: Understand Java syntax and object-oriented programming.

lessons.title: Java Basics
lessons.content: Java is a strongly typed object-oriented language that runs on the JVM.

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.content: Classes are blueprints, while objects are instances created from classes.

lessons.title: Inheritance and Polymorphism
lessons.content: Inheritance reuses code and polymorphism allows one interface to support many forms.
